source_excerpt: 'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47' (AK 47), starring Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty and Nara Rohith, has collected Rs 33.95 cr worldwide within its first two days in theatres. The Telugu movie recorded an increase in domestic earnings on Saturday, October 31, collecting Rs 10.40 cr net across 3,192 shows. This marked a 6.7% rise over its opening-day collection.The film's India net collection has reached Rs 20.15 cr, while its domestic gross stands at Rs 23.60 cr. Overseas markets have contributed Rs 10.35 cr in gross earnings, including Rs 2.75 cr from Saturday's screenings, as per Sacnilk reports.According to Bollymoviereviewz, the movie was made on a production budget of Rs 128 cr, inclusive of promotional expenses. Its current worldwide gross is still considerably below that figure. Based on the reported collections, the film needs to earn more than four times its existing worldwide gross to match the estimated budget.Sacnilk data shows that Saturday was the movie's strongest day so far. It generated an average of Rs 32,581 per show, while its overall occupancy also improved compared with the opening day.'Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47' registers a Saturday riseThe film collected Rs 9.75 cr net in India on Friday, October 30. Its second-day earnings increased to Rs 10.40 cr, with the corresponding gross collection rising from Rs 11.40 cr to Rs 12.20 cr.The number of screenings also moved up from 3,073 to 3,192. Overall occupancy improved from 44.1% on the opening day to 48.1% on Saturday. The increase in collections made its second day stronger than the first, giving the movie a positive start to its opening weekend.Overseas markets contribute Rs 10.35 crInternational territories have provided a substantial contribution to the film's early box-office total. The movie added Rs 2.75 cr in overseas gross on Saturday, taking its cumulative international earnings to Rs 10.35 cr.Combined with the domestic gross, this has pushed its worldwide collection to Rs 33.95 cr. The Telugu 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 47.60% on Saturday. Morning screenings registered 25.08%, while afternoon shows reported 45.54%.The turnout increased further during the evening, with occupancy reaching 51.54%. Night shows recorded the highest audience attendance at 68.23%. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana generated the largest share of the film's tracked domestic gross on Saturday. The two states contributed Rs 9.75 cr, accounting for 79.9% of the day's total.Karnataka followed with Rs 1.70 cr, while Tamil Nadu added Rs 40 lakh. The rest of India contributed Rs 33 lakh, and Kerala recorded Rs 2 lakh. These regional figures together account for the reported domestic gross for Saturday.Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the Telugu movie features Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty and Nara Rohith in the lead roles. The supporting cast includes Nivetha Pethuraj, Vennela Kishore, Satya Akkala, Rao Ramesh and Brahmaji.The story follows Chittibabu, Swarna and the members of their household at House No. 47. Their seemingly happy family life takes an unexpected turn when buried secrets and tensions begin to surface.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources.
